preheader: Anthropic sets IPO date, Workday suffers outage, and McKinsey offers scandal advice.

lead.headline: Anthropic Prepares for Public Trading as Co-Founders Face Multi-Billion Payouts
lead.body: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic is preparing to go public with trading expected to begin on November 19. Founded in 2021 by a team of seven co-founders, the company is set to make its founders multi-billionaires upon listing.
lead.why: Tracking AI startups as they transition to public markets helps you evaluate tech valuations and exit strategies for your finance classes.

stories.headline: Workday Payroll Outage Hits Thousands of Enterprise Clients
stories.body: Workday suffered a major service disruption on Friday, leaving thousands of companies without access to payroll and human resources management software. The outage comes just days after a separate widespread shutdown at Microsoft.
stories.why: Understanding enterprise software reliability gives you insight into corporate operational risk and vendor stability.

stories.headline: Fed Vice Chair Says Inflation Determines Interest Rate Decisions
stories.body: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson stated that elevated price pressures mean inflation remains the key factor for future interest rate policy. He noted that economic and labor market indicators currently show signs of stability.
stories.why: Interest rate expectations directly impact corporate borrowing costs and equity valuations across capital markets.

stories.headline: Take-Two CEO Calls Out AI Companies Over Game Cloning
stories.body: Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick criticized Anthropic and OpenAI for allowing users to replicate existing video games using generative AI. Zelnick called it ironic that AI firms stomp on established intellectual property.
stories.why: Intellectual property disputes around generative models will shape business models and legal liabilities in tech startups.

stories.headline: Attacker AI Use Triggers New Ransomware Concerns
stories.body: Cybersecurity researchers warn that unsophisticated attackers are increasingly leveraging AI tools to launch disruption campaigns. While fully automated ransomware has not yet arrived, accessible AI tools are accelerating attack frequency.
stories.why: Cybersecurity risks represent a growing line item in enterprise IT budgets and strategic risk consulting.

stories.headline: McKinsey Chief Shares Crisis Blueprint for Boardrooms
stories.body: McKinsey global managing partner Bob Sternfels recommended corporate boards run scenario planning exercises for executive leadership scandals. His advice comes after Nvidia faced major market value losses following public scandal fallout.
stories.why: Crisis management framework building is a core service management consultants deliver to corporate leadership teams.

stories.headline: McKinsey Report Warns of Slower Air Travel Growth
stories.body: A report from McKinsey reveals that 56 percent of airlines expect slower passenger growth over the next two to three years. The study points to rising fuel costs, aircraft delivery delays, and geopolitical uncertainties as key operational headwinds.
stories.why: Analyzing industry-specific headwinds helps you practice building revenue forecasts and strategy case solutions.

stories.headline: UC Irvine Men's Basketball Rolls to 90-40 Victory
stories.body: The Anteaters opened with 19 straight points and dominated the glass with a 71-29 rebounding margin against Lincoln University to remain undefeated.

stories.headline: Mirra Andreeva Finishes Undefeated in WTA Finals Group Stage
stories.body: Teenager Mirra Andreeva completed a sweep of her group-stage matches at the WTA Finals in Indian Wells, stating she is learning to recover faster from court setbacks.

term.name: Initial Public Offering (IPO)
term.definition: An Initial Public Offering is the process where a private corporation offers shares to the public in a new stock issuance. This allows early investors and founders to gain liquidity while raising capital for operational expansion. Anthropic's expected public trading on November 19 is an example of an AI market debut.

serve.headline: Drogue raises $20M for ocean-based AI data centers
serve.body: Six-month-old startup Drogue secured $20 million in funding from XYZ Venture Capital and Toyota Ventures. The company uses warm ocean surface water to generate power for floating data centers.
